newsitem.title: USA: Louisiana natural gas leak traced to ANR pipeline.
newsitem.headline: Louisiana natural gas leak traced to ANR pipeline.

text.p: The U.S. Coast Guard on Monday said a natural gas leak in Louisiana's Vermilion Bay was traced over the weekend to an ANR Pipeline Co six-inch pipeline.
"The ANR Pipeline Co has taken responsibility for it. They are going to put a clamp on it and fix the line," Coast Guard Petty Officer Chip Thompson said.
An ANR Pipeline spokesman was not immediately available for comment. The company, a unit of Coastal Corp, last week said the pipeline flowed at two to four million cubic feet per day.
The leak forced several pipelines in the onshore waters of Vermilion Bay shut in for pressure testing last week.
